{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

data.info()
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(data.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'\nNumber of rows: {len(data)}')
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {data["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {len(data) - data["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
duplicates = data[data["patient_id"].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f'\nNumber of patients with multiple rows: {duplicates["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Show how many rows per patient
print('\nDistribution of sample_seq per patient:')
print(data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())"}
